about: Skills tool: descriptive statistics. Solver and generator: ApBioProblems (bio/assets/tools/bio-skill-problems.js), kind descriptive. contexts drive the seeded practice problems; problems are fixed, with expect holding the solver's answers (the validator recomputes them).
intro: Summarize a small data set the way the exam expects: the mean, the median, the range, the sample standard deviation and the standard error. Type each answer, check it, and every step of the working appears.
howItWorksTitle: The formulas, and how answers are checked
howItWorks:
mean x̄ = Σx / n

s = √( Σ(x − x̄)² / (n − 1) )

SE = s / √n

  • The median is the middle value once the values are sorted (the mean of the two middle values when n is even). The range is largest minus smallest.
  • The standard deviation s measures how spread out the values are. Divide by n − 1 because the data are a sample, not the whole population.
  • The standard error SE measures how precisely the sample mean estimates the true mean. Larger samples give smaller SE.
  • An answer counts when it is within one unit of the last decimal place asked for. For s and SE it may also be within 1%, so rounding the mean on the way does not cost you the point.
